decision: Keep the 2pc on the existing generic path: ntesim_data::stat_projection applies the GetEfficiency_2 additive pack (+0.12 ChargeGetEfficiencyBase, empty ConditionArray) once set_count reaches the SuitStructList threshold, on top of the native 1/1 ChargeGetEfficiencyBase base; the studio build projection accumulates it into charge_efficiency (1 + 0.12 = 28/25 at counts 2/3/4) through the existing charge-efficiency consumer (crates/content/src/build/studio_projection.rs lines 436 and 489), and the native build compiles it as a GearProcConfig::ChargeEfficiency multiplier via the generic path (crates/content/src/build/stats.rs project_charge_efficiency). No set-specific proc is introduced for the 2pc. The 4pc stays on the existing shared cast-buff path: parameters come from the frozen CT_Equipmentbuff curves via set_passive_values::timed_set, the trigger is the wearer's Ultimate cast (InputActionRole::Ultimate filter), the buff is queued with BuffTickOrExpiry priority before same-time damage (bd9a1ca), and the recipient/refresh semantics are TimedBuffDeclaration::reset with BuffRecipient::TeamAll, RefreshPolicy::Reset, max_stacks 1. No new mechanism was introduced for the 4pc either.
hypothesis_rationale: The frozen Suit11 row names pack GetEfficiency_2 for SuitCondition 2; DT_EquipmentModifyData defines it as one additive +0.12 ChargeGetEfficiencyBase entry with an empty ConditionArray, which the shared additive-pack interpreter accepts as an unconditional static pack. Threshold gating (set_count >= 2) and empty-ConditionArray acceptance are the generic, already-reviewed stat_projection rules, not new Speedy Hedgehog claims. The native 1/1 base plus the +0.12 accumulation is the existing charge_efficiency model per EQUIPMENT_CONTRACT (charge_efficiency = accumulated ChargeGetEfficiencyBase; the native character base contributes 1.0), verified independently by the studio baseline test showing charge_efficiency = Ratio::one() with no set and 28/25 with a manual 3/25 addition. Four-piece runtime hypotheses (recorded as 'speedy_hedgehog.proc_v1' = 'Ultimate activation refreshes a shared nonstacking team base-ATK effect. Module count declares matching geometry.' plus the shared 'cast_buff_order' hypothesis): (a) only the wearer's Ultimate cast triggers the buff — the frozen description names the wearer casting Ultimate, and on_cast filters on InputActionRole::Ultimate, so redirected skills/QTEs are excluded; (b) the +15% / 20s values are the frozen CT_Equipmentbuff curve values at Time 1.0 (the only keys; sets have no refinement tiers); (c) 'all allies' maps to BuffRecipient::TeamAll, i.e. every team member including the wearer, each scaled by its own base ATK; (d) 'Effect does not stack' maps to RefreshPolicy::Reset with max_stacks 1, so a repeated Ultimate refreshes the 20s deadline instead of adding a stack; (e) the buff applies before same-time damage (bd9a1ca ordering) — a tested model rule, not native execution evidence. The 2pc hypothesis id stays the receipt's primary identity; the 4pc hypotheses are named above and recorded in every Studio run that attaches the proc.

limits: Path split: the native static equipped build (crates/data/src/equipment/compiler/pipeline.rs, tested by native_build_marks_four_piece_unresolved_with_threshold) still reports the 4pc in unresolved_set_buffs with threshold 4 and the Buff_Equipment_GetEfficiency2_4 blueprint reference — the modeled GearProcConfig::SpeedyHedgehogTeamAtk lives on the Studio scenario path (studio.rs set_procs + runtime callbacks), not in the native build compiler. The two paths describe the same frozen effect; the Studio path is the modeled one.

The 4pc Ultimate-trigger semantics (wearer only; InputActionRole::Ultimate filter excluding redirected skills/QTEs), the 15%/20s values, the TeamAll recipient, and the non-stacking refresh are the modeled hypotheses speedy_hedgehog.proc_v1 plus the shared cast_buff_order hypothesis — tested in the runner, not native client observations. Reopen only with frozen evidence or client observations that contradict them (e.g. native stacking of repeated casts, a different recipient scope, or different same-time ordering).

Buff application before same-time damage (bd9a1ca ordering, CausalPriority BuffTickOrExpiry=3 before HitDelivery=4) is a tested model rule recorded as CAST_BUFF_HYPOTHESIS, not verified native execution order.

Native expiry-boundary timing is unverified: the runner treats a hit exactly at current_time+duration as unbuffed (covered by the existing combined test's 25s hit); whether the native client keeps the buff through its deadline timestamp is unknown.

Studio proc attachment requires the Studio consumer's count>=threshold gating on has_buff effects (verified read-only in web/src/domain/language/native-build.ts); native equipped builds and the Rust simulation tests bind gear_procs directly, bypassing that gating.

The static 2pc pack claim rests on the generic stat_projection additive-pack interpreter and the existing charge-efficiency consumers; no Speedy Hedgehog specific proc, callback or Studio set_procs entry exists for the 2pc.
